speaker: Sam Chen
summary: From Galatians 5:19-23, joy is not manufactured or pursued but is the fruit of living by the Holy Spirit; the two steps are to remove what steals joy (the acts of the flesh, by rooting our identity in Jesus rather than trying harder) and to pursue the Spirit by knowing, following, and obeying God's Word and pointing to Jesus in every circumstance; also calls the church to gently restore and hold one another accountable in community.

speaker: Joe Henseler

title: Trusting God's Protection
speaker: Tim Azevedo
summary: From Psalm 5 (in a series on joy), David laments honestly to God amid betrayal and finds joy in God's protection and justice - protection defined not as the absence of harm but the presence of God in it, ultimately secured by Jesus.
